# Remove the test-module build registration with the unused module file

1897 deletes the whole NewMailAccountHelpers.sys.mjs file and its TESTING_JS_MODULES.mail entry together. The accepted file is absent and the build list retains the surviving helper modules. A local integration recommendation is to treat the source path and packaged testing resource as one removal scope. This verifies registration cleanup, not every test importer or a successful build. The module’s PascalCase Helpers.sys.mjs name is historical and does not establish a naming rule for new code. This is static source and test-code inspection at the fixed accepted revision. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline and inline discussion remain pending.

Scope: mail testing module registration.
